question: Which catalyst from the literature is reported with a higher biodiesel yield than GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4, and at what temperature was it run?
rendered: The CaO/HAP/MnFe@K catalyst has shown a conversion rate of 99.10%, which is higher than the 98.74% reported for GO-Gd2TiO5/g-C3N4. The temperature at which this catalyst was run is not specified in the provided excerpts.
